WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS rental_payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
), avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_payment_total) AS avg_rental_payment_total
  FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.rental_payment_total) AS combined_payment_total,
       AVG(rt.rental_payment_total - a.avg_rental_payment_total) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM rental_totals rt
CROSS JOIN avg_total a
WHERE rt.rental_payment_total > a.avg_rental_payment_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id;
